items.title: An additive and unit-equivariant transformation with flat target is a morphism of module-valued functors
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file adequate.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: If a transformation phi : F -> G of module-valued functors on Alg_A is additive, commutes with multiplication by units of B, and G satisfies the flat base change property, then the lemma asserts that phi is a morphism of module-valued functors, i.e. respects the B-module structure (statement lines 749-762). The proof is short but entirely explicit: for b in B it forms the faithfully flat extension B' = B[x, y, x^-1, y^-1]/(x + y - b), so that G(B) is a subgroup of G(B'), writes b = x + y with x, y units in B', and computes phi(b xi) = phi((x+y) xi) = x phi(xi) + y phi(xi) = (x+y) phi(xi) = b phi(xi) (proof lines 764-777). The level is H3: the trick of adjoining two units summing to b is the whole content, and it is carried out completely, with the faithful flatness step named.
